details.completeness_justification: The candidate summary adequately covers K1 (revenue growth), K2 (EBITDA exceeding threshold), K3 (capital investments surge), K4 (free cash flow increase), and K8 (record dividend distribution). However, it omits core material components for K5 (5G frequency block acquisitions), K6 (planned network expansion investment details), K7 (mobile data traffic growth necessity for investment), K9 (new data center construction), and K10 (management appointment). While several HIGH importance criteria are met, the omissions of multiple HIGH importance items (K5, K6, K7, K9) and the MEDIUM importance item (K10) prevent the summary from achieving a 'Yes' rating. The overall coverage is mixed with substantial gaps in strategic investments and operational context.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is fully coherent internally. All statements are logically connected without contradictions. Revenue growth is consistently described across periods and segments (S2-S4, S15-S16). Profitability metrics (S5-S9) show logical progression from revenue to operating profit to net profit. Operational metrics (S15-S17) align with revenue drivers mentioned earlier. The dividend payout (S18) and balance sheet items (S19) are presented as separate factual statements without conflicting with other data. There is no unnecessary repetition, and the summary forms a clear narrative from revenue performance through profitability to operational metrics and capital structure. All numerical relationships are presented as standalone figures without implying arithmetic contradictions.
